suite.description: Three synthetic Python file-edit/test episodes, frozen before inference. Tests are immutable. Not a real repository benchmark.

cases.issue: memoize calls the wrapped function repeatedly when its cached result is falsey. Cache every successful result, including None, 0, False, and an empty string. Preserve positional and keyword call support. Do not cache exceptions.
cases.visible_tests:
calls=[]
@memoize
def f(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x
assert f(0)==0 and f(0)==0
assert calls==[0]

cases.issue: chunks(items, size) must accept a one-pass iterable, yield nonempty lists of at most size items, and include a short final chunk. Empty input yields nothing. size <= 0 must raise ValueError when the result is consumed. Existing list behavior should remain.

elapsed_seconds(start, end) loses full days and fractional seconds and incorrectly wraps negative durations. Return the signed total number of seconds between datetime objects as a float, preserving microseconds and timezone-aware datetime subtraction.
cases.source:
def elapsed_seconds(start, end):
    return float((end - start).seconds)
cases.visible_tests:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
s=datetime(2026,1,1)
assert elapsed_seconds(s,s+timedelta(days=2,seconds=3))==172803.0
cases.hidden_tests:
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
s=datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
for delta in (timedelta(microseconds=123456),timedelta(days=-3,seconds=2),timedelta(0),timedelta(days=5,seconds=4,microseconds=5)):
    value=elapsed_seconds(s,s+delta)
    assert isinstance(value,float) and value==delta.total_seconds()
assert elapsed_seconds(s,s.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=3))))==0.0
